name: select-state-on-parent
message: `:hover` under select.child("a") is the state of this element, not of the a
help: for the a's own state, put it in the target: `[select.child("a:hover")]`; for this element's, read it through a relation

name: select-state-on-parent
message: `:focus-visible:hover` under select.descendant("svg") is the state of this element, not of the svg
help: for the svg's own state, put it in the target: `[select.descendant("svg:focus-visible:hover")]`; for this element's, read it through a relation
